MEALS.title: Meal claim
MEALS.article: Daily caps are $95 tier 1, $75 tier 2, $58 tier 3, per person including tax and tip. Alcohol is never reimbursable. Client meals may exceed the cap only with advance manager approval and names on the receipt.

LODGING.title: Lodging claim
LODGING.article: Nightly caps are $320 tier 1, $240 tier 2, $180 tier 3. Book through the corporate travel tool where a compliant option exists. Above-cap stays need written approval before booking, not after.

EQUIP.title: Equipment or home office claim
EQUIP.article: Home office allowance is $500 every two years, covering desk, chair, lighting, or a second monitor. Furniture over $500 needs an ergonomic assessment first. Handset purchases are never reimbursed.
